title: Vallee and Davis six-level UAP paper
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Vallee and Davis six-level UAP paper, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: jacquefully and eric davis put out a very nice paper of six levels of uap phenomena which range all the way from nuts and bolts at the bottom to spiritual or metaphysical aspects at the top

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a paper by Jacques Vallee, a longtime UFO researcher, and Eric Davis, a physicist, that sorts UAP, the newer official term for UFOs (unidentified anomalous phenomena), into six levels. According to Michels, the levels run from "nuts and bolts" physical craft at the bottom up to spiritual or metaphysical sides of the experience at the top. He praises it as a way of holding all those layers in one picture.
